metadata.rule: plan docs/specs/day-2026-09-14/plan.md D1-D3 at the merged revision; procedure text in evidence/task-2026-09-14/README.md

records.title: Blade Tip Clearance Measurement Systems for High Speed Turbomachinery Applications and the Potential for Blade Tip Timing Applications
records.reason: Metrology: capacitive tip-clearance systems measuring individual blade clearances to 90,000 rpm; compares passive and active probe approaches with stated bandwidth and uncertainty. Direct candidate method for the dynamic-clearance channel; no defect comparison.

records.title: Numerical investigation on the influence of nonuniform tip clearance on rotor tip-clearance flow field structure
records.reason: Title names nonuniform tip clearance and its effect on rotor tip-clearance flow structure (numerical). Plausible competitor for the nonuniform-versus-mean question; abstract not retained, so relevance is queued for close reading rather than graded.

records.title: Improving the blade tip clearance measurement method based on blade tip timing: Accounting for rotor speed variations and non-uniform blade-by-blade tip clearance
records.reason: Title names a blade-tip-timing clearance method that accounts for rotor speed variation and non-uniform blade-by-blade tip clearance. Directly relevant metrology for per-blade dynamic clearance; abstract not retained. Same title as the SSRN record below.

records.title: On the development of a magnetoresistive sensor for blade tip timing and blade tip clearance measurement systems
records.reason: Metrology: simultaneous blade tip timing and tip clearance with a magnetoresistive sensor; reviews optical, capacitive, eddy-current and microwave probe options and their processing dependence. Candidate method class and a source on method-to-method disagreement.

records.title: Laser-Optical Blade Tip Clearance Measurement System
records.reason: Metrology: laser-optical system measuring single-blade and average tip clearance in rotating rigs and engines, with bench and environmental tests. Historical (1981) but a direct optical-method reference for the clearance channel.

records.title: Non-Uniform Flow in a Compressor due to Asymmetric Tip Clearance
records.reason: Aerodynamics: analytical actuator-disc model of flow redistribution from asymmetric tip clearance, mean plus perturbation. Adjacent evidence on how circumferentially non-uniform clearance changes the flow at a given mean; analytical, compressor, no measurement.

records.title: Turbine Blade Tip Clearance Measurement Utilizing Borescope Photography
records.reason: Metrology background: rub pins in turbine shrouds photographed by borescope to determine running clearance in an engine. A contact-witness approach; informs the contact-detection option in the requirements draft, not a dynamic sensor.

records.title: Turbine Blade Tip Clearance Improvement
records.reason: Turbine hot-section structural design (diaphragm attachment, thermal matching) to reduce clearance without rubs. The measurement technique is unnamed and incidental; the abstract positively describes engine structural design, not a clearance-defect comparison or a measurement method usable here.

records.title: Analytical Methods for Transonic Compressor Rotor Blade Tip Clearance Measurements Using Capacitive Probes
records.reason: Metrology: post-processing and calibration method for capacitive tip-clearance probes on a transonic fan under transient loading; once-per-revolution resampling into the spatial domain to improve SNR. Directly relevant to per-revolution clearance processing and synchronization requirements.

records.title: Improving the Blade Tip Clearance Measurement Method Based on Blade Tip Timing: Accounting for Rotor Speed Variations and Non-Uniform Blade-by-Blade Tip Clearance
records.reason: SSRN preprint carrying the same title as the Measurement 2025 record; queued with it so the two versions are read together and counted once. Abstract not retained.

records.title: Techniques for blade tip clearance measurements with capacitive probes
records.reason: Title names techniques for blade tip clearance measurement with capacitive probes (Meas. Sci. Technol., 2000). Relevant method reference for the clearance channel; abstract not retained.

records.title: Capacitive blade tip clearance measurements for a micro gas turbine
records.reason: Title names capacitive blade tip clearance measurement for a micro gas turbine, the closest scale to a small-UAV rotor among the metrology hits. Abstract and year not retained; queued on title.

records.title: Tip Clearance Investigation of a Ducted Fan Used in VTOL Unmanned Aerial Vehicles—Part I: Baseline Experiments and Computational Validation
records.reason: Ducted-fan VTOL UAV tip-clearance study (559 mm rig): experiments with Kiel probes and six-component force/torque plus RANS CFD, baseline and validation. Adjacent evidence on tip-leakage loss versus clearance in exactly this class of machine; whether clearance is varied non-uniformly or at equal mean is not stated in the excerpt. Journal version of the 2011 conference paper; Part II is a separate record.

records.title: Review of Progress in the Development of Capacitive Sensors for Blade Tip Clearance Measurement
records.reason: Metrology review: capacitive sensor designs (composite and integral) and electronics for compressor and turbine tip clearance. Method-class reference for the clearance channel.

records.title: Effects of Non-Axisymmetric Tip Clearance on Axial Compressor Performance and Stability
records.reason: Experimental and analytical study of circumferentially non-uniform tip clearance on a four-stage low-speed compressor; excerpt states stall-margin loss was more severe than an average-clearance estimate and that the circumferential length scale of the asymmetry mattered. This is the closest retained evidence for the 'beyond mean clearance' question; abstract does not say whether mean clearance was held equal across cases. Highest close-reading priority.

records.title: The Measurement of Turbomachinery Blade Vibration Through Tip Timing With Capacitance Tip Clearance Probes
records.reason: Metrology background: dual use of a commercial capacitance clearance probe for blade tip timing (vibration). Informs whether one probe class can serve clearance and timing; the excerpt is about vibration detection, so low priority.

records.title: Tip Clearance Investigation of a Ducted Fan Used in VTOL UAVS: Part 1—Baseline Experiments and Computational Validation
records.reason: Conference version (22-inch rig) of the ducted-fan VTOL UAV tip-clearance baseline study; same authors and structure as the 2013 journal Part I. Queued with it; counted as one study unless the texts differ.

records.title: Theoretical Studies of Tip Clearance and Radial Variation of Blade Loading on the Operation of Ducted Fans and Propellers
records.reason: Theory: actuator-disc and surface-singularity treatment of radial tip clearance and blade-loading distribution for ducted fans and propellers. Background on clearance effects in ducted propellers; no defects, no measurement.

records.title: Blade tip clearance measurement method based on blade tip timing without the once per revolution sensor
records.reason: Metrology: laser-triangulation blade-tip-timing clearance measurement without a once-per-revolution sensor; two processing methods. Relevant to the timing/synchronization requirements and to the dynamic-clearance method shortlist.

records.title: Research on Tip Clearance Measurement Technology of Aero-engine Blade Based on Optical Fiber Sensing System
records.reason: Metrology: three-coil coaxial optical fibre bundle sensor for dynamic radial-gap detection, designed to reject reflectivity and angle variation. Same sensor class as day-1 source S5; candidate for the clearance channel.

records.title: Feasibility verification of a vertically foldable propeller
records.reason: A vertically folding propeller blade for a multi-rotor vehicle; the excerpt is about folding the blade to reduce lateral size and testing blade efficiency. No duct, shroud, clearance or clearance metrology; the retrieval query matched 'foldable' and 'propeller' only.

records.title: Optimized Shroud Design for Axial Turbine Aerodynamic Performance
records.reason: Axial-turbine blade-tip shroud study: full, non-axisymmetric partial and optimized partial shrouds at identical clearance, measured and simulated. 'Shroud' here is the blade-mounted tip shroud, a different object from a duct; retained as an analogue of geometry change at fixed clearance, low priority.

records.title: A Blade-by-Blade Tip Clearance Measurement System for Gas Turbine Applications
records.reason: Metrology: blade-by-blade tip clearance measurement system commissioned on a compressor facility, with a performance analysis. Direct reference for per-blade measurement and commissioning practice.

records.title: Tip Clearance Investigation of a Ducted Fan Used in VTOL Unmanned Aerial Vehicles—Part II: Novel Treatments Via Computational Design and Their Experimental Verification
records.reason: Ducted-fan VTOL UAV Part II: CFD-designed tip treatments varied in chordwise location and circumferential width, with experimental verification. Adjacent evidence on circumferentially varying tip geometry in this machine class; not an equal-mean clearance comparison as far as the excerpt shows.

records.title: Effects of Tip Clearance of Nozzle Vanes on Performance of Radial Turbine Rotor
records.reason: Radial turbine with variable nozzle vanes: effect of nozzle-vane tip-clearance leakage on rotor-inlet flow distortion and rotor performance. The clearance is at the stator vanes, not the rotor tip, and the machine is a radial turbine; the excerpt positively places it outside both the rotor-tip defect question and the metrology need.
